rows.change: If the enemy has a Panic range of 1-2 or higher, reduce the Range by 1.
The enemy adds +1” to Speed, +2” if it is 4” or below.
Increase Combat Skill by +1 to a maximum of +2.
Increase Toughness by +1 to a maximum of 5.
Aggressive and Beast AI types change to Rampaging. Tactical AI changes to Aggressive. Defensive and Cautious AI types change to Tactical. Others do not change.
Roll 1D6 for a special ability on the table below, or add an extra one.
Gain a 6+ Armor Saving Throw or add +1 to an existing Saving Throw.
